subject: 英语
source: 人教版PEP小学英语（三年级起点）教材单元话题整理
original_text:
【核心词汇】red 红色; green 绿色; yellow 黄色; blue 蓝色; black 黑色; brown 棕色; white 白色; orange 橙色; OK 好; mum 妈妈
【重点句型】Good morning! 早上好！ This is ... 这是…… Nice to meet you. 很高兴见到你。 Colour it brown. 把它涂成棕色。 Good afternoon! 下午好！
【A Let's talk】Miss Green: Good morning, boys and girls. Students: Good morning, Miss Green. Miss Green: This is Mr Jones. Mr Jones: Nice to meet you. Wu Yifan: Nice to meet you, too.
【Read and write】White: Hello, I'm Miss White. Black: Hello, I'm Mr Black. Blue: Hi, I'm Miss Blue. Brown: Hi, I'm Mr Brown. Orange: Good morning! Red: Good morning!
key_points: Nice to meet you. 很高兴见到你。
Colour it brown. 把它涂成棕色。
cautions: 只做内容骨架（核心词汇、重点句型、对话与短文范例），不生成老师逐字讲解稿；词汇与句型均依据该 PEP 单元目标语言整理，不得编造教材未出现的单词、语法点或例句。
